segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: Blackjack, she calls it. Here we call it Twenty-One Coffins, and it is the same game with a better name: closest to twenty-one without going over beats the house. No fancy games for you, then, only honest arithmetic. Name your bet, and tell me: will you play each card, or let one stroke of fortune settle the round?
